name: 🤸 Trampoline Park Tycoon!
desc:
🏃‍♂️ Welcome to Trampoline Park Tycoon! In this experience, you build a massive trampoline park filled with many obstacles and cool minigames such as a basketball trampoline area, ziplines, parkour area, and more! You can find other peoples trampoline parks down the road!

🤔Want to submit ideas, hear about the latest news, updates, and more? Make sure you join the group! 
https://www.roblox.com/groups/4413376/Split-Second-Studios#!/about

🛠️Trampoline Park Tycoon Update🛠️
- New monetization (due to recent updates by Roblox)
- Notifications for in-game rewards

Trampoline Park Tycoon, by Split Second Studios

Compatible with all devices.
